title: WU-TRIB V1 — repaired candidate capability catalog
detectedDefect: 21 of 22 entries used positional inputs in place of priority, shifting output/behavior/risk/oracle/dependencies. Module 001 aligned.
restorationMethod: For 002..022 map previous proposedPriority to inputs; inputs to outputs; outputs to behavior; behavior to risk; criticalRisk to acceptance; minimumFutureAcceptance to dependency IDs. Preserve original module and domain.

modules.title: Source Extractor
modules.behavior: Supports synthetic XML/EFD/CSV/Excel and future authorized read-only ERP snapshots; capture file identity, schema, release, job, org, period and checksum. Distinguishes truncation and rejection from empty valid set.
modules.risk: Partial extraction or overwritten source silently invalidates every downstream procedure.
modules.acceptance: Recorded file rows/bytes/hash agree with input; truncation returns BLOCKED; no read/write outside permitted scope.

modules.title: Data Profiler
modules.behavior: Profiles types, distribution, missing/zero, distinct counts and invalid patterns before rule execution;  no silent type coercion.
modules.risk: Unknown quality or types can create false joins or trend conclusions.
modules.acceptance: Numeric/date/codes preserved; complete field coverage; counts and totals reconcile.

modules.title: Normalizer & Type Contract
modules.behavior: Normalize CPF/CNPJ only as allowed, codes, dates, decimals, timezone and whitespace with recorded transformations;  preserve raw values.
modules.risk: Incorrect casting or lost leading zero corrupts tax keys and amounts.
modules.acceptance: Roundtrip where reversible; types precise; no float for tax amounts; originals preserved.

modules.title: Join & Match Studio
modules.behavior: Inner, left/right/full outer, semi, anti, composite and controlled range/temporal joins;  preview 1:1, 1:N, N:M and estimated multiplication;  fuzzy match advisory only.
modules.risk: Many-to-many explosion double-counts tax bases and hides missing documents.
modules.acceptance: Count conservation per cardinality, missing/duplicate keys flagged, totals not inflated and original sources unchanged.

modules.title: Selection & Filter Builder
modules.behavior: Boolean conditions, date windows, ranges, regex with bounds, null logic and saveable named cohorts. Keep analytical filters separate from statistical sampling and risk selection.
modules.risk: Undisclosed excluded records lead to biased coverage.
modules.acceptance: Population, exclusions and selection reason reconcile; deterministic filters and boundary cases pass.

modules.title: Master Data & Entity Resolver
modules.behavior: Record organization, branch, participant, product, fiscal category, UF, tax regime and changing classification with source and temporal validity;  never infer the actual customer SX3.
modules.risk: False entity match or expired master data yields false rule result.
modules.acceptance: Key/crosswalk precision, historical snapshot consistency, conflicting identities quarantined.
modules.note: Architectural and limited definition; not automatically a production launch feature.

modules.title: Statistical & Directed Sampling
modules.behavior: Separate random/systematic/stratified/MUS where suitable from judgmental targeted selections and 100% tests;  permit projection only for justified probability methods and competent review.
modules.risk: Convenience sampling incorrectly generalized to population.
modules.acceptance: Replay same seed; correct inclusion population; no extrapolation from targeted sample; sample risk recorded.
modules.note: Architectural and limited definition; not automatically a production launch feature.

modules.title: Duplicates Gaps & Sequence
modules.behavior: Detect duplicate composite keys, gaps, overlap, cancelled number ranges and inconsistent sequence per branch/series;  avoid treating lawful cancellation as fraud.
modules.risk: Confusing authorized voided numbers with omissions.
modules.acceptance: Expected duplicates and gaps detected; legitimate exclusions documented; no automatic fraud conclusion.

modules.title: Stratify / Summarize / Materiality
modules.behavior: Group by amount, date, product, supplier, tax code, branch, percentile;  materiality is governance input, not default R$ 0.01 for all cases.
modules.risk: Using universal threshold can hide material risk or trigger excessive exceptions.
modules.acceptance: Grouped totals reconcile to ungrouped population; rounding/threshold boundaries deterministic.
modules.note: Architectural and limited definition; not automatically a production launch feature.

modules.title: Error & Exception Classifier
modules.behavior: Distinct classes: parse/schema, reference/master data, arithmetic, temporal/legal, reconciliation, system/transport, anomaly, expected exception, insufficient evidence. Separates confirmed technical errors from suspected fiscal issues.
modules.risk: Ambiguous error label becomes an unsubstantiated noncompliance assertion.
modules.acceptance: Every issue has category, affected records, field, rule, source, expected/observed, owner and uncertainty.

modules.title: Anomaly Detection & Explainability
modules.behavior: Deterministic first: robust z-score, IQR, peer comparisons, bursts, unusual combinations;  optional AI only after separate governance. Signals do not equal errors or fraud.
modules.risk: Rare but valid transaction flagged; biased cohorts; false positives or model drift.
modules.acceptance: Golden cases; precision/recall on synthetic labelled data; group context and thresholds exposed; reviewer override logged.
modules.note: Architectural and limited definition; not automatically a production launch feature.

modules.title: Temporal Change & Period Comparison
modules.behavior: Compare MoM/YoY/rolling across volume, amounts, effective rates, CST/CFOP/NCM, TES/IDTRIB, regime, bases and parameters;  decompose price/volume/mix/rule. Declared legal change distinct from observed change.
modules.risk: A rate difference from mix or retroactive adjustment mistaken for law change.
modules.acceptance: Same population comparability/coverage and denominators, restored snapshots, branch comparability, missing periods flagged.
modules.note: Architectural and limited definition; not automatically a production launch feature.

modules.title: Multi-Source Reconciliation
modules.behavior: Two-way to four-way reconciliation as contracts dictate (XML×EFD×SFx/SFT×contabilidade ou estoque), keep counts & totals by side with drill-down and exception grouping.
modules.risk: Premature matches or netting hide unresolved items.
modules.acceptance: Side-specific coverage, all exceptions preserved, no unapproved auto-match across different organizations.

modules.title: Tax Rule & Layout Validator
modules.behavior: Validate known layout, effective date, tax code and calculation preconditions;  unsupported/ambiguous source triggers HOLD. Fiscal conclusion remains human.
modules.risk: Applying incorrect vigência or legal interpretation creates incorrect tax exposure.
modules.acceptance: Independent official oracle/version evidence, boundary/negative cases; no APPROVED by engine.

modules.title: Parameter Change Inspector
modules.behavior: Diff past/new TES, SF4, fiscal parameter, profile, IDTRIB and control values by source and validity;  separate intentional releases from silent configuration drift.
modules.risk: No snapshot or unclear shared-table semantics makes a change unverifiable.
modules.acceptance: No claim about customer config without authorized snapshot; unchanged fields correctly ignored.
modules.note: Architectural and limited definition; not automatically a production launch feature.

modules.title: Fiscal Impact Scenario & What-if
modules.behavior: Compare tax effects of parameter/rule changes without writing ERP entries, calculating refunds, or issuing fiscal/legal conclusions;  simulations explicitly counterfactual.
modules.risk: Hypothetical credit or tax saving mistaken for recoverable amount.
modules.acceptance: Isolation of synthetic scenarios; no payable/claim recommendation absent human/legal sign-off.

modules.title: Tax Opportunity Candidate Finder
modules.behavior: Identify candidates for unclaimed credits or changed classifications only where legal source and limits exist;  separate risk of overclaiming and statutory restrictions.
modules.risk: False tax opportunity leads to wrongful compensation or filing.
modules.acceptance: Always NOT_EVALUATED; estimated impacts labelled conditional; evidence & legal review required.

modules.title: Accounting & Stock Tie-Out
modules.behavior: Link fiscal records to accounting and inventory with multi-leg reconciliation and transaction sign orientation;  avoid double-counted reversal entries.
modules.risk: Timing vs period close difference interpreted as missing transaction.
modules.acceptance: Balance bridge, signs and period boundaries explained; separate unresolved vs timing differences.

modules.title: Risk Scoring & Investigation Queue
modules.behavior: Weighted severity/impact/exposure with explainable factors;  risk ranking does not certify tax correctness. Approval and closure need owner and evidence.
modules.risk: Black-box score masks severe item or drives unfair prioritization.
modules.acceptance: Trace factors, manual override, no redaction of critical issues; independent risk review.

modules.title: Evidence & Workpapers Builder
modules.behavior: Evidence chain WHO/WHAT/WHEN/WHY with static files, sampled/whole-pop indication, links to WO control and test;  detached from UI pagination.
modules.risk: Lost provenance makes work irreproducible; excessive PII exposure.
modules.acceptance: Reproduce exact inputs and runs; no fabricated signature; retention/classification rules.

modules.title: Visual Procedure Composer & Scheduling
modules.behavior: Drag/drop or guided steps as a future UX candidate;  orchestrate Extract→Profile→Join→Select→Exception→Report with preview/dry-run and quota;  allow read-only steps first.
modules.risk: User-defined joins/actions access unauthorized data or consume excessive resources.
modules.acceptance: Validate dependency DAG/tenancy/quotas, show projected input/output, support rollback or cancel safe.

modules.title: Dashboard & Recurring Audit Reports
modules.behavior: Cards and time-series based on verified aggregation, explain methods and denominator, drill-down to source. No automatic issuance of fiscal opinion.
modules.risk: Vanity metrics or inconsistent totals mislead the auditor.
modules.acceptance: Dashboard totals tie-out to evidence; period and sources visible; accessible keyboard/assistive tech.
